title: Recasting AI Data Centers as Engines for Carbon Removal
summary: AI data centers (AIDCs) are rapidly increasing electricity demand and associated CO2 emissions, yet they also generate continuous low-grade waste heat. Here, we assess whether this heat can be upgraded by heat pumps to drive direct air capture (DAC) and reduce the climate impact of AI infrastructure. We develop a thermodynamically integrated DAC-AIDC system and conduct a region-resolved assessment across the United States, accounting for AIDC capacity, server composition, local climate, electricity prices, and grid carbon intensity.
